mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0 percentage points, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day returns in periods with UNRATE > 5.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate robust economic expansion, which correlates with positive 60-day S&P 500 returns due to rising corporate profitability.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in periods with HOUST > 1000 and INDPRO > 100 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising industrial production (INDPRO) alongside declining retail sales (RSAFS) reflects overproduction and weakening consumer demand, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in late-cycle expansion regimes with INDPRO rising and RSAFS falling are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in periods with CPIAUCSL > 240.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 thousand units consistently precede positive short-term equity market performance due to increased construction activity and consumer confidence, yielding positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day returns in periods with HOUST > 1000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and stable interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.6%) during labor market recovery phases generates positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through improved corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in periods with PAYEMS > 145000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.6 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In consumer demand recovery regimes, rising retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal strengthening household spending, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in consumer demand recovery regimes with RSAFS > 460000 and HOUST > 1000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
